programs.title: Strip The City S2 - "Chicago"
programs.desc: CGI strips Chicago’s Willis Tower and L-rail to reveal how green roofs, deep tunnels, and heat-proofed bridges protect 10 million citizens.

programs.title: Strip The City S2 - "Machu Picchu"
programs.desc: Stripping away the granite, CGI reveals the quake-proof walls and hidden canals that allowed Machu Picchu to survive at 11,000 feet.

programs.title: Strip The City S2 - "Los Angeles"
programs.desc: Stripping Los Angeles to its core, CGI reveals the hidden steel and fault lines that help this earthquake-prone city survive "the Big One."

programs.title: Strip The City S2 - "New Orleans"
programs.desc: CGI peels back the Superdome and the city’s silt to reveal the massive pumps and barriers keeping New Orleans from sinking.

programs.title: Strip The City S2 - "New York"
programs.desc: Dissecting New York's stone and steel, CGI reveals the inflatable subway plugs and bedrock foundations shielding the city from Atlantic superstorms.

programs.title: Strip The City S2 - "Paris"
programs.desc: Using a virtual scalpel, CGI strips the Eiffel Tower to its 17-foot base and peels back the boulevards to expose 180 miles of ancient quarries.
